50: - `browser`: browser/web inspection capabilities plus only the local read context it needs;
51: - `bug-auditor`, `architecture-auditor`, `final-gate`, `project-ro`: read-only effective authority;
52: - `test-engineer`: test execution and evidence gathering without unrelated write authority unless explicitly required by the contract;
53: - `project-rw`: write/execute only inside the explicit delegated scope.
54: 
55: A delegated role must not inherit Holo's broad tool authority merely because the harness supports inheritance. If the native mechanism cannot preserve the role boundary, use the smallest faithful role-specific adaptation or report the limitation.

57: ## Holo direct work versus delegation
58: 
59: Holo may use any project-approved capability directly when delegation would add little value. Delegation exists for specialization, independent review, context isolation, cost control or useful parallelism; it is not required merely because a specialized tool exists.
60: 
61: This means, for example, that Holo may use a native integrated browser directly for a quick visual check while still delegating a larger browser investigation to the canonical `browser` role when isolation or specialization helps.
